subject: Controlling size of dots and binwidth on geom_dotplot() without printing the error?

messages.author: 24ad378ead154fbd
messages.subject: Controlling size of dots and binwidth on geom_dotplot() without printing the error?
parts:
Hi folks!

I've written a nice little loop that generates an identical dotplot with PersonGroup on my x axis (there are three groups) and QueryGeneExpression on my y. I have 10 genes in total and I'd like the graphs to be uniform as they'll all be displayed together as panels, but I can either control binwidth (gives me different sized dots but no error, looks terrible) or dotsize (gives me beautiful graphs but also an output I can't get rid of so my par(mfrow(2,5)) doesn't run). 

Is there a way I can remove the output? I already am running warning=FALSE in my R markdown chunk.

Hope you can help!

Best wishes

Sarah
